payload.title: genesis_lifecycle._replay is documented to return an InvalidLifecycleChain value and never raise, but validate_transition raises on a malformed row (int() of a non-numeric valid_cycles, .get on a non-dict evidence), and lifecycle_chains replays every entity, so one entity's bad row makes every change_intelligence mint and request validation fail
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_lifecycle.py:71-84 (InvalidLifecycleChain: 'a value, not a raise'; the ledger may hold any row an appender writes)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_lifecycle.py:103-128 (_replay calls validate_transition for every row with no containment)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_lifecycle.py:185-188 (int(evidence.get('valid_cycles') ...) raises ValueError on a non-numeric value)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_lifecycle.py:138-141 (lifecycle_chains replays every entity of the ledger in one pass)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_surface.py:425-433 (_seat_claims walks every chain, so another entity's bad row is read on each seat resolution)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:1669 (the mint asks allowed_targets_for_role, which reaches that walk)
payload.rule_violated: SE-5 lifecycle owner contract: one reader replays the ledger and an invalid chain is a value that makes the entity not ACTIVE, never a crash (genesis_lifecycle.InvalidLifecycleChain docstring); a reader that fails closed must fail per entity.
payload.notes: A row for an unrelated entity is appended through the declared-ledger API with to_state CANDIDATE_PROPOSED and evidence {valid_cycles: 'many'}. record_transition would have refused to write it, but the ledger accepts any appended row, which is the threat the replay docstring names. Replaying that entity raises ValueError instead of returning InvalidLifecycleChain; because _seat_claims replays every entity, allowed_targets_for_role('change_intelligence') and service_seat_agents raise the same error, so every change_intelligence mint (agent_invocations.py:1669) and request validation (agent_contract.py:224) fails until the row is removed. The reviewer's probe reproduced the ValueError through both entry points. Close condition: Make the row reads in validate_transition and _replay total: coerce or refuse a non-numeric count and a non-dict evidence into reasons on the chain (InvalidLifecycleChain) instead of raising. Add a test in test_se5_lifecycle_replay.py that appends such a row for entity other-a and asserts current_lifecycle_state('other-a') is an InvalidLifecycleChain and allowed_targets_for_role('change_intelligence') still answers for the other entities. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
